page.layout: One column of running text, full width. Running head at top, page number at top right. Gathering signature at foot left of centre. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: lasij constitutum ex illo Canone adsum-ptum esse, nec ullâ aliâ ratione pro-bat suam hanc assertionem, quàm istâ, agi scilicet in hoc Gelasij constituto, perinde ac in Canone Apostolico, de simoniacè promoto ac promovente, ar-ceatur dans pariter accipiensque. Sed nul-lâ inde necessariâ consequentiâ deduci potest Gelasij sanctionem ex Canone Apostolico adsumptam esse, si nullum hac de re indubitatum extaret Gelasio vetustius Decretum, aliquam forte veri speciem haberet Viri docti ratiocinatio: sed cùm plura reperiantur ejusmodi De-creta in veris ac genuinis Antiquitatis Ec-clesiasticæ monumentis, quin ad ea res-pexerit Gelasius nullus dubito; primò ha-bemus S. Basilij Epistolam ad Episcopos sibi subjectos, quæ in novissimâ Canoni-carum SS. Patrum Epistolarum editione, ut illius Canon XCI. repræsentatur, in hac autem Epistolâ agit cótra simoniacos, vetátque ne in posterum propter pecunias fiant ordinationes,historiam tangit Simo-nis Magi, qui pecuniâ spiritus sancti gra-tiam emere volebat, & depositioni subji-cit juxta Balsamonis explicationem tam eos qui ordinant, quàm qui ordinantur, sive ante ordinationem pecunias acce-perint vel dederint; sive post ordina-

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout (e.g. "refpexerit" read as "respexerit", "Epiftolâ" as "Epistolâ"). Page number printed as "5I" in the old figure style; transcribed as 51. The word "ordinationes,historiam" has no space after the comma as printed. Accents on "cótra" and "vetátque" are as printed.
